title: Broken field reference
description:
Layout-quality rule — a layout object references a field or table occurrence that no longer exists. Resolution runs over the numeric IDs (field ID within the target table, table-occurrence ID within the file), never over UUIDs: cross-file references routinely carry a stale UUID while the field itself is perfectly intact, and FileMaker resolves them by ID at runtime. Objects whose target file is missing from the catalog are skipped as unverifiable, and container objects are excluded because their XML embeds the markup of their children.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Broken Field" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A field reference with no target renders as <Field Missing> in FileMaker. The object occupies space, takes part in the tab order and silently drops whatever it was supposed to show.
rule.remediation: Point the object at an existing field, or delete it if the data it showed is gone for good.
